collection.description: A healer has one clean dressing left for a villager and a badly injured animal.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A healer has one clean dressing left while a villager and a badly injured animal both need care.

choices.label: Ask for more hands and supplies

text_only.reason: an animal is no villager; the villager already needs care, nobody is hurt now

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The healer treats the more urgent case first and improvises safe alternatives for the other.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: A team cleans equipment and shares tasks, though resources remain strained.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A promising substitute works in one case but cannot replace all medical supplies.
